summary: Phase III.8 backend test pass. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_8_procurement.py with 40 tests covering procurement CRUD, 3-quote rule, QCBS threshold, L1-or-justify rule, lifecycle (award/close/cancel/link-claim), ABC Pareto analysis, and Phase I-III.7 regression. 40/40 passing.

minor.issue: Review-request bullet states 'estimated_amount_inr=10000000 → Three_Quote', but 10,000,000 = ₹1Cr (100L) > ₹75L QCBS threshold, so implementation correctly returns 'QCBS' (matches the documented 'QCBS for >₹75L' rule and the _procurement_method_for code at lines 473-480). The problem statement bullet is inconsistent with both the plan and the implementation; the implementation is correct. Test updated to reflect actual (correct) behaviour.

Endpoint accepts ANY non-terminal status, not just Awarded. The route has no status guard (server.py:1754-1764) — a Draft PR could be marked 'Closed' directly. Consider enforcing transition only from Awarded or Linked_To_Claim. Not blocking, but worth tightening.
Also has no status guard — a Closed or Cancelled PR can be re-cancelled. Idempotent, but should reject from terminal states (Closed).

action_items: Confirm intended behaviour for 10000000 (₹1Cr) — implementation returns QCBS (correct per >75L rule). Update the problem-statement bullet to match if it was a typo.
Optional: add status-transition guards to /procurement/{id}/close (only from Awarded/Linked_To_Claim) and /cancel (reject from Closed/Cancelled).
Optional: validate quote_amount_inr > 0 and quote_date format on POST /procurement/{id}/quotations (currently any string accepted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2486 lines — split into routers (procurement.py, claims.py, finance.py, bodies.py, seed.py) for maintainability. Already past the 700-line guidance.
_procurement_method_for has two branches both returning 'Three_Quote' (lines 476-479) — collapse the redundant if-blocks. The QCBS threshold logic is correct but the dead branch makes intent unclear.
close_procurement/cancel_procurement lack status guards (any status → terminal) — see minor issues above.
ABC bucketing in /finance/abc-analysis (server.py:1789-1830) is well-implemented and uses prev_cum_pct correctly so the boundary item stays in A as documented.
Award route's L1 check (server.py:1714-1721) correctly enforces notes>10 chars only when awarded != lowest-quote vendor — clean implementation.
Three_Quote 3-quote enforcement happens at /award (line 1700) — good. But /quotations allows unlimited quotes past 3, which is fine but worth noting.
MongoDB _id properly excluded everywhere via {"_id": 0} projections — no leakage observed.
test_credentials: none required (no auth on these endpoints)
